name: Click n Chat (Chat Widget Integration)
author: Adeel Abbasi

sections.description:
Click n Chat is a 100% FREE WordPress chat widget plugin that allows you to connect with your website visitors through popular messaging and social platforms using a floating chat button.

With Click n Chat, you can add WhatsApp chat, Telegram chat, Facebook Messenger, Instagram, Email, SMS, and many other platforms to your website — all in one lightweight and customizable chat widget.

The plugin includes smart auto-replies, availability scheduling, drag-and-drop profile management, and Google Analytics tracking to help you engage visitors and improve communication without any subscriptions or hidden costs.

🔹 Key Benefits

  • Fully FREE – no Pro version, no paid upgrades
  • Floating chat widget for instant communication
  • Supports multiple social and messaging platforms
  • Smart auto-reply chatbot functionality
  • Easy customization with no coding required
  • Mobile-friendly and responsive
  • Google Analytics (GA4 & Universal) support

Features

1. Multi-Platform Chat Support

Connect your visitors using their preferred platform:
– WhatsApp
– Telegram
– Facebook Messenger
– Instagram
– Skype
– Snapchat
– Viber
– Line
– Email
– SMS
– Google Maps
– TikTok
– Slack
– LinkedIn
– VK

2. AI-Powered Chatbot (Multi-Provider)

  • Enhance conversations using modern AI providers
  • Supported AI Providers
  • OpenAI (ChatGPT)
  • Claude (Anthropic)
  • Google Gemini
  • HuggingFace Inference API
  • Cohere
  • DeepSeek
  • Key Highlights
  • Switch AI providers anytime from settings
  • Only required API fields appear dynamically
  • Unified AI engine (single backend class)
  • HTML-formatted AI responses for clean chat display
  • Compatible with PHP 7.4+

3. Social User Profile Management

  • Create multiple chat profiles
  • Set agent name, role, and description
  • Enable or disable profiles anytime
  • Drag & drop profile sorting
  • Set availability times per weekday
  • Choose custom icons for each platform

4. Floating Chat Widget

  • Clean bottom-right popup chat button
  • Displays all active chat platforms
  • Opens chat instantly with pre-filled details
  • Non-intrusive and fast loading

5. Auto-Reply Chatbot

  • Keyword and query-based auto replies
  • Percentage-based matching for accuracy
  • Works even when agents are offline
  • Fully customizable responses

6. Design & Customization

  • Popup header text and colors
  • Padding, borders, and icons
  • Pre-defined widget styles
  • Custom greeting message

7. Google Analytics Integration

  • Track chat widget clicks
  • Supports GA4 and Universal Analytics
  • Measure user engagement easily

8. Responsive & Developer-Friendly

  • Works on desktop, tablet, and mobile
  • Cross-browser compatible
  • Lightweight and optimized
  • Hooks and filters for developers
sections.installation:
1. Install Click n Chat from the WordPress plugin repository or upload it to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Open WhatsApp Users in the WordPress admin menu and configure your chat profiles.
sections.faq:
Is Click n Chat free?

Yes. Click n Chat is completely free with no Pro version or paid upgrades.

Which chat platforms are supported?

WhatsApp, Telegram, Facebook Messenger, Instagram, Email, SMS, and many more.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes. The chat widget is fully responsive and works on all devices.

Can I customize the chat widget?

Yes. You can customize colors, icons, text, layout, and greeting messages.

Does it support auto replies?

Yes. Click n Chat includes a built-in auto-reply chatbot feature.

Can I track clicks with Google Analytics?

Yes. It supports Google Analytics 4 and Universal Analytics.
